channel.title: Mine action news — Global Mine Action Hub
channel.description: News about humanitarian demining in Ukraine and around the world: short summaries of key events with a link to the original source, and updates from Global Mine Action Hub.

item.title: UMAC 2026 in Brussels: partners pledge about €70 million for demining in Ukraine
item.description: The fourth Ukraine Mine Action Conference took place in Brussels on 16–18 November. Partner countries announced commitments of about €70 million for humanitarian demining.

item.title: Ukraine's state demining programme: 691 hectares of farmland cleared in October
item.description: In October 2026, operators cleared 691 hectares of agricultural land under Ukraine's state humanitarian demining programme. In total, 110 completed contracts have returned 20,709 hectares to use.

item.title: A demining dog teaches children in Ukraine how to stay safe
item.description: In frontline cities such as Kharkiv, Chivas, a trained mine detection dog, helps Save the Children teach children to recognise explosive hazards.
